articles.summary: Thousands of customers were affected by supply disruptions during high temperatures in May South East Water has reported a half-year loss after penalties and £29m of costs following disruption to water supplies over the summer.
key_points: The company, which serves about 2.4 million customers across south-east England, recorded a pre-tax loss of £22.9m in the six months to 30 September, compared with a profit of £18.2m during the same…
